# Cloudinary Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that manages media on Cloudinary: upload images and videos, list and inspect assets, update metadata/tags, delete assets, and check plan usage. The free plan is credit-based across storage/bandwidth/transformations — run `usage` before heavy work and stay inside the plan. Confirm before uploading (it consumes bandwidth/transformation quota) and before deleting (deletes are permanent). Uses cloud_name + API key + secret from the Cloudinary Console (Settings, API Keys), kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from Cloudinary's public Upload and Admin API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
